limits: These ledgers record policy and boundary reviews; full native verification is a separate gate.
Private corpus source, identities, local paths and identifying hashes are excluded.
Useful constraints, references, legal notices, tool directives and actual documentation consumers retain explicit protections.
PostgreSQL ordinary, partial and expression indexes remain separate from CREATE TABLE.

enforcement.SARJ016: Reject prefixed narration, bounded section labels and exception-header prose; preserve real constraints, references and directives.
enforcement.SARJ099: Unconsumed module docstrings emit errors; standalone deletion is offered only when metadata, legal notices, encoding and remaining syntax are preserved.
enforcement.SARJ420: Ordinary unconsumed class prose emits errors; actual documentation consumers and framework contracts remain protected.
enforcement.SARJ434: Exact ordered paragraph lines that mechanically repeat AST-owned direct call names emit errors from two lines and twelve words; unproven prose and technical explanations are preserved. The safe deletion subset remains stricter.
enforcement.SARJ439: Two terminal qualified-value equality branches plus fallback emit an error when subject and namespace stability are proven. No new automatic rewrite.
enforcement.SARJ510: Both model and data unions without a shared disjoint Literal discriminator emit errors. Constructor and serialized compatibility remain a manual contract decision.
enforcement.SARJ528: Opaque application contracts emit errors; source-proven raw validators, parser outputs, framework hooks and genuinely opaque interoperation retain their contracts.
enforcement.SARJ121: New unconditional empty PostgreSQL tables inline equivalent constraints when ordering, table state and constraint semantics allow. No automatic SQL rewrite.

suppression_boundary: A broad exclusion of SARJ420 does not disable the independent SARJ099 module policy. Embedded suppression text inside a string is not a source comment.

fact_preservation_audit.method: Each changed block was compared with current names, types, validation and tests; unchanged moved blocks were excluded. Technical facts were not treated as valueless.

corpus_qualification.measurement_status: Fresh integrated candidate measurements complete; selected live hits fully reviewed by exact source and diagnostic identity.

historical_review.status: Historical findings retained unchanged, not current measurements

comparator_context.integration_upstream: separately pinned current integration upstream comparator

corpus_qualification.measurement_method: Three fresh-process cold/warm rounds for original baseline, previous upstream comparator, separately pinned integration_upstream, candidate and control; all five modes use the original unchanged 468-file/6,741,860-byte corpus and default 250-file bound. Projecting each round onto the four previous modes preserves their exact prior relative order. Cold includes fresh-interpreter imports without flushing the host page cache; warm repeats once in the same batch process. Control remains no-secret-in-log on the candidate engine. The fixed1.25 budget uses only the original baseline; both upstream ratios are additional disclosed comparators. Focused overhead is not full-ruleset performance.
limits: Live-hit labels and labeled example confusion are separate cohorts.
Changed source or diagnostic identities require fresh human review.
No private source, paths, revisions or identifying hashes are included in this aggregate.
Historical performance is never substituted for this new report.
SARJ434 abstains from prose that cannot be mechanically proved redundant; one previously reviewed noisy walkthrough with a retainable fact now abstains.
No unknown live findings were converted into positive labels; exact identity transfer reuses actual prior manual judgments.
The fixed25% budget is against the original baseline. Against the separately pinned integration upstream, focused cold time rises13.4%, warm time33.2%, and peak process RSS14.5%.
Original-baseline timings vary across historical runs. Ratios below one in this run are not a claim that the complete product became faster.
Cold means a fresh interpreter, without flushing the host filesystem cache.

scope.live_hit_sampling: Complete intended-service census plus the predeclared deterministic random sample of up to 25 maintained-source findings per code.

review_context.constraint_remediation: Preserve hidden constraints in concise local comments or executable contracts; class docs do not receive automatic deletion.

independent_upstream_changes.context: Upstream independently made the transactional SQL architecture policy blocking after this audit; it is excluded from this change's twelve promotions.

integration_continuity.scope: Both upstream commits have the same measured Python/contracts projection. The retained 17-rule results apply to the identical engine and immutable corpus. The React Doctor adapter and complete Standards bundle were not benchmarked.
